<style>
/* KIMS homepage – custom CSS for the Elementor container template.
   Only covers what Elementor's native controls cannot do. Every rule is scoped to
   the template's own classes (.kims, .kims-*), so nothing else on the site changes.
   The template already embeds this file in its first HTML widget; if you move it to
   Site Settings > Custom CSS (Pro) or Appearance > Customize > Additional CSS,
   delete that widget. */

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
.kims { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }
.kims .elementor-widget-text-editor p { margin: 0; }
.kims .elementor-widget-text-editor p + p { margin-top: 1em; }
.kims a:focus-visible, .kims select:focus-visible, .kims .elementor-tab-title:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #d1a64a; outline-offset: 4px;
}

/* Eyebrow: short gold rule before the label (.eyebrow:before) */
.kims-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title::before {
  content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 2px; margin-right: 12px;
  background: currentColor; vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Gold second line of the hero heading */
.kims .kims-gold { color: #d1a64a; }

/* Sticky white header (Elementor Free has no sticky option) */
.kims-sticky-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; }
.admin-bar .kims-sticky-header { top: 32px; }
@media (max-width: 782px) { .admin-bar .kims-sticky-header { top: 0; } }

/* Buttons: small lift on hover */
.kims-btn .elementor-button { transition: background .18s, transform .18s, border-color .18s; }
.kims-btn .elementor-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }

/* Text links: underline on hover, stay inline-sized */
.kims-text-link .elementor-button { min-height: 0; }
.kims-text-link .elementor-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.kims-quick-link .elementor-button-content-wrapper { justify-content: flex-start; }

/* Hero media: extra left fade into the navy copy column (second gradient in the HTML) */
.kims-hero-media { isolation: isolate; }
.kims-hero-media::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10283b 0%, transparent 18%);
}
.kims-hero-caption { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
@media (max-width: 767px) { .kims-hero-media::after { display: none; } }

/* Card hover lift (.program-card:hover) */
.kims-lift { transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
.kims-lift:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(16, 40, 59, .09); }

.kims-campus-card h3 { margin: 0; }

/* FAQ toggle: bottom rules only, like the original <details> list */
.kims-faq .elementor-toggle-item { border-bottom: 1px solid #d4dfe5; }
.kims-faq .elementor-tab-title, .kims-faq .elementor-tab-content { border: 0 !important; }
.kims-faq .elementor-toggle-icon { font-size: 1rem; }

/* Map tone */
.kims-map iframe { filter: saturate(.7); }

/* Contact rows: links inherit the row colour, underline on hover */
.kims .elementor-heading-title a { color: inherit; }
.kims .elementor-heading-title a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* Footer */
.kims-footer .kims-brand-sub {
  display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 8.3px; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.3;
}
.kims-footer-legal a { color: inherit; }
.kims-footer-legal a:hover { color: #d1a64a; }

/* Mobile quick-action bar pinned to the bottom of the screen */
.kims-mobile-bar { position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 40; }

/* Pathway selector (HTML widget) */
.kims-path label { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #172b3a; }
.kims-path select {
  width: 100%; padding: 13px 15px; border: 1px solid #9cafb9; border-radius: 3px;
  background: #fff; color: #10283b; font: inherit;
}
.kims-path-result {
  min-height: 180px; margin-top: 22px; padding: 20px;
  background: #f8f7f2; border-left: 4px solid #d1a64a;
}
.kims-path-result small {
  color: #8a641c; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
}
.kims-path-result h3 {
  margin: 10px 0 8px; color: #10283b; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -.045em; line-height: 1.12;
}
.kims-path-result p { margin: 0 0 14px; color: #647686; font-size: .9rem; }
.kims-path-link { color: #10283b; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 700; }
.kims-path-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  .kims *, .kims *::before, .kims *::after { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; }
  .kims-lift:hover, .kims-btn .elementor-button:hover { transform: none; }
}
</style>

tabs.tab_title: Which grades and programmes does KIMS offer?
tabs.tab_content: KIMS offers Grades VI–VIII, O Level and A Level at its Gulberg II campus. Playgroup–Grade V is offered through Lahore School of Learning at a separate Gulberg III location.

tabs.tab_title: How does the admission process work?
tabs.tab_content: Submit the admission form and required documents. KIMS reviews prior results and may require an admission test. If an offer is made, admission is final once the fee is paid.

tabs.tab_title: Can I visit the campus before applying?
tabs.tab_content: Contact KIMS to arrange a visit and confirm a suitable date and time.

tabs.tab_title: Where can I check the latest fees and scholarships?
tabs.tab_content: Read the published fee guide and scholarship page, then contact admissions to confirm the details for the current session.
